_comment: Specification for the Runpod Serverless endpoint. NOT created: creating it needs the owner's separate approval. Items marked UNVERIFIED have not been exercised on a real worker.
name: bhoomi-beta-v1
spend_controls: gateway GPU-second budget and kill switch

env.HF_TOKEN: secret reference, read-only, scoped to the one private adapter repo

unverified: tool-call output of the LoRA model under the vLLM hermes parser matches the llama.cpp local runtime (run the parity probe, plan section 11)
the adapter's chat template is honoured by the worker (CUSTOM_CHAT_TEMPLATE or an equivalent); the adapter was trained with its own template
LoRA selected by name through the OpenAI-compatible route
cold-start time from a private HF repo with the base weights not baked into the image
data_policy: The worker receives only prompts that the Core builds from allowed tool outputs and user questions. It never receives data files, the feedback database or restricted datasets.
